# NOTICE

This repository is a private fork of [black-ant/Ant-Browser](https://github.com/black-ant/Ant-Browser),
vendored and modified for use in Memoh (https://github.com/felinics/Memoh) under the working name
"antmemo" — replacing Memoh's built-in Chromium with Ant-Browser as the per-bot browser
instance/profile/proxy manager, running the fingerprint-chromium core
(https://github.com/adryfish/fingerprint-chromium).

At the time this fork was made, the upstream black-ant/Ant-Browser repository carried no LICENSE
file (its README stated one would be added later). This fork is distributed under Memoh's own
license (GNU AGPLv3, see LICENSE) as a deliberate, informed decision by Memoh's maintainers.
This does not assert any additional rights over the original upstream work beyond what is
necessary for Memoh's internal use and modification.

Modifications made by Memoh in this fork are tracked via the git history following the mirror
commit and via tags prefixed `antmemo-`.
